_comment: Example 5: Test Execution (evidence with log type)

input.description: Run integration tests for backend API endpoints. Verify all CRUD operations work correctly.

output.conclusion: Integration tests completed with 45/50 tests passing. 5 tests failed due to database connection timeout. The failures are intermittent and may be related to test environment instability.

evidence.snippet:
[INFO] Tests run: 50, Failures: 5, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
[ERROR] testCreateShare - Connection timeout after 30s

com.mysql.cj.jdbc.exceptions.CommunicationsException: Communications link failure
The last packet sent successfully to the server was 0 milliseconds ago.

evidence.description: One of the failing test methods

risk.description: Database connection instability may indicate production environment issues
risk.mitigation: Investigate database connection pool settings and network stability

next_steps.action: Investigate database connection timeout root cause
Increase connection timeout in test configuration temporarily
Re-run failed tests after timeout adjustment
